goal: Blinded Experiment 5 trial t-089: evaluate chi(T,E,K) over the supplied task package, persist a typed topology decision under an observable propose transition, then realize exactly one legal branch — local resolution under the current topology, or root-mediated creation of one validated, attenuated, fresh child — followed by deterministic verification.

nodes.instructions: Read every file in package/ (task.json, artifacts/, evidence requirements) plus contract.json, decision-schema.json and this harness. Acquire evidence only; decide nothing yet.
nodes.why_necessary: chi(T,E,K) is a function of the task, the available evidence, and the contract; the evidence state must be acquired as a distinct causal step before any decision is representable.

nodes.instructions: Evaluate chi(T,E,K) -> {CREATE, DO_NOT_CREATE} and write decision.json conforming to decision-schema.json. Record the decision in the ledger as a propose event with metadata.artifact_type=topology_decision and metadata.decision set. The decision artifact is capability-bearing: it must cross this observable propose transition before anything else happens.
nodes.why_necessary: The endogenous topology choice is the capability under test; it must be a typed, externally observable proposal persisted before any realization, not an implicit side effect.

nodes.instructions: Only after a DO_NOT_CREATE decision: resolve the task under the current topology. Write resolution.json (verdict, findings, evidence) using only the package artifacts.
nodes.why_necessary: The DO_NOT_CREATE branch must terminate in a local resolution or an honest local failure; this node is its sole authoring locus.

nodes.instructions: Re-read resolution.json against the task deliverable specification; record the structural check outcome. Local and non-authoritative: deterministic root verification governs.
nodes.why_necessary: K-E5-trial requires the verify primitive in any Write-holding topology; a structural self-check before return is the minimal fulfilment.

nodes.instructions: Write result.json (final trial answer, child_invocations=0) and finalize the session ledger. Do not emit a complete event: trial completion is recorded by the root lifecycle log after deterministic verification.
nodes.why_necessary: Mandated return locus for the local branch; without it the resolution never re-enters the governed boundary.

nodes.instructions: Only after a CREATE decision: author the full child bundle under child/ — child-contract.json (within the child envelope, attenuated), child-harness.json (linear observe -> produce-evidence -> self-check -> return chain), child-prompt.md (complete standalone instructions incl. the child ledger contract), child-input-manifest.json (exact package files the child receives; clean-room exclusions honored), integration-plan.json (deterministic rule mapping child evidence to the final result). Every file is capability-bearing and must appear under an observable propose event.
nodes.why_necessary: The CREATE branch requires a defined epistemic role, a bounded contract, and a compilable topology before realization; this node is their sole authoring locus. Authoring is proposal: it grants and realizes nothing.

nodes.instructions: Re-read the child bundle against the child envelope, the schema constraints and the assigned unresolved distinctions; record the structural check outcome. Non-authoritative: kernel validation governs.
nodes.why_necessary: Verify primitive required for the Write-holding branch; the author must not silently certify its own bundle — this check is recorded and then superseded by deterministic validation.

nodes.instructions: Write result-pending.json (decision summary, assigned distinctions, expected child contribution, integration rule reference) and finalize the session ledger. The parent session ends here; realization is root-mediated only after validation.
nodes.why_necessary: Returns the proposal into the governed boundary; the decision-maker holds no realization authority, so its branch must end in a returned proposal.

nodes.instructions: Deterministic validation of the returned bundle: decision_validator on decision.json, kernel compilation of child-harness.json under child-contract.json, check_attenuation(K-E5-trial, child-contract), input-manifest containment with clean-room exclusions, integration-plan executability. Any failure rejects realization.
nodes.why_necessary: Realization is allowed only after child validation; this is the governing gate between proposal and creation (protected rule of K-E5-trial).

nodes.instructions: Realize the validated child via the deterministic fresh launcher only: sanitized environment, explicit fresh session id, persisted provenance. The ledger records create (topology realization) and a persist event with event_kind=child_launch referencing the launch provenance.
nodes.why_necessary: The sole legal realization locus; creation must be causally after validate-child by construction of the declared dependencies.

nodes.instructions: Receive the child deliverables (child result, evidence, execution ledger) into the trial record; ledger event return with event_kind=child_return.
nodes.why_necessary: The child result must observably re-enter the governed boundary before integration; a child whose output never returns contributes nothing.

nodes.instructions: Deterministic task verification of the local branch: run the preregistered verify method for this trial against result.json.
nodes.why_necessary: A trial answer is evidence only after deterministic verification; model self-checks are non-authoritative.

nodes.instructions: Deterministic integration and task verification of the child branch: execute the parent's integration-plan rule over the returned child evidence, produce result.json mechanically, then run the preregistered verify method.
nodes.why_necessary: Integration is deterministic execution of the parent's pre-committed rule — the root never solves the substantive task; verification then governs the outcome.

branch_semantics.statement: The compiled LTS permits both branches from the post-decision state; a conforming runtime realizes exactly one. Kernel-level complete requires all nodes done and is therefore unreachable by construction in a branching trial; trial completion is recorded in the deterministic lifecycle log and branch exclusivity is enforced by the topology guard (deterministic topology-decision checker per the conditional-topology semantics).

decision_conditional_legality.DO_NOT_CREATE: all descendant launch transitions (validate-child, create-child, child-return, verify-trial-child realizations; any launcher invocation) are illegal for the trial
decision_conditional_legality.CREATE: realization is legal only after validate-child passes (attenuation, compilation, freshness preflight); local-resolve realizations are illegal

ledger_contract.path: execution-ledger.jsonl (parent workspace root; root appends realization events to the trial ledger trial-ledger.jsonl)
ledger_contract.schema: normalized formal event schema: one JSON object per line with event_id, label, actor, timestamp, artifact_refs, metadata; node executions carry metadata.completes_node; the closed kernel alphabet is used, with metadata.event_kind distinguishing decision / child_launch / child_return refinements
ledger_contract.forbidden: no complete event in the trial ledger (unreachable in the branching LTS); no create/persist(child_launch)/child_return events in a DO_NOT_CREATE trial; no local-resolve events in a CREATE trial
ledger_contract.optional_events: additional non-authority events (observe, propose, validate, consult, reject, persist, reconstruct, return) with actor 'creator' or 'root' are permitted as governance self-loops; tau lines permitted for silent internal steps with metadata.reason
